enable_fuse.description: Enable the FUSE filesystem client. Set to true to activate the mount.

mountpoint.description: Absolute path where the GNUNET FUSE filesystem will be mounted. Must exist and be accessible.

uid.description: Numeric user ID of the process owner. Typically 0 (root) unless running in user namespace.

gid.description: Numeric group ID of the process owner.

permissions.description: Octal permission bits for the mountpoint (e.g., '0700' for owner-only, '0755' for world-readable).

max_pending.description: Maximum number of concurrent I/O requests. Higher values improve throughput on fast systems.

lazy_listing.description: If enabled, directory entries are fetched on-demand rather than fully upfront — improves responsiveness with large directories.

idle_timeout.description: Seconds of inactivity after which the mount is automatically unmounted (to save resources).

identity_key_file.description: Path to the peer's private identity key (used to authenticate this mount to other peers).

mount_options.description: Additional FUSE mount options (strings) — e.g., 'allow_other', 'allow_root', 'utime_ok'. Leave empty for defaults.

items.description: A valid libfuse mount option string.

log_level.description: Verbosity of logging for the FUSE subsystem.
